# Gateway reference

## Ports

The gateway listens on port 8700 and forwards widget requests to port 8701.

## Restart

Restart the gateway with `widgetctl gateway restart`. A restart takes about ten
seconds; requests made during that time get HTTP 503 and should be retried.

## Status

Check the gateway with `widgetctl gateway status`. It prints the uptime, the
listening ports and the number of open connections.
